title: Fix TSK-0383 unrequested concurrency regression (sequential instead of concurrent subscribers)
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG5-05 / F40 (memorysmith-standards-spec-review-26-07-15-11-56-27)

## Problem
TSK-0383's fix for subscriber fault isolation silently changed subscriber execution from concurrent (`Task.WhenAll`) to sequential (`foreach`+`await`). No test asserts either model. Publish latency is now sum of all subscribers instead of max. This was an unrequested side-effect of the fix bundle.

## Severity
Medium (High if many subscribers)

## Files
- `MemorySmith.Core/Services/IMemoryChangePublisher.cs`

## Recommendation
Revert to concurrent execution with per-handler catch-and-log inside `Task.WhenAll`. Add concurrency-asserting test with two subscribers where one throws.

## Existing Coverage
Extends TSK-0383 (Done, incomplete).
